scope: Public copy, destination grouping, accessibility, responsive ergonomics, and information-boundary review for src/components/dashboard/Footer.tsx and footer.module.css.
decisions: Grouped destinations by Product, Learn, Account, and Company & support so the footer mirrors the primary product mental model without duplicating navigation labels.
Replaced vague product/private-access copy with consumer-facing image creation and discovery language.
Added one clear Image Studio action, consolidated legal links into the bottom row, and retained system status plus support contact as the only operational help destinations.
Removed the legacy Visual Library destination and routed account/profile access to the private settings profile tab.
Added a concise public-by-default creation disclosure without exposing internal implementation or authorization details.

quality_checks.detector: No deterministic impeccable findings for the footer component or stylesheet.
quality_checks.touch_targets: Primary, brand, footer, legal, and back-to-top controls use a 44px minimum height.
quality_checks.keyboard: Native links and button retain visible focus rings and logical DOM order; the back-to-top control remains a button.
quality_checks.responsive: Existing one-, two-, and five-column breakpoints remain intact; link groups wrap naturally in the bottom legal row.
quality_checks.public_boundary: No private access, topology, credential, provider, routing, or operational implementation copy is published by the footer.
quality_checks.build: Production build completed successfully with 164 generated static pages.

limits: No production deployment or live-site acceptance is implied.
Browser localhost acceptance remains unavailable in the sandbox; production HTML output and static route/assets were inspected instead.
